jmcombs-pi-1password.notes: [Agent-assisted preparatory review, not Tyler-verified — read before approving.] Reviewed at fork commit 733bb02439ed1f633909a7142bbbefb412245f81 (upstream jmcombs/pi-extensions, MIT, verified LICENSE text). Scoping: NONE — index.ts:786-795 spawnHook merges the entire resolved-secret map (all non-LLM-provider auth.json keys) into every bash/! child process unconditionally; no per-tool or per-project restriction exists in this package. ADR-002 already assigns the actual boundary to the separate permission-system fork (gotgenes-pi-packages, still candidate). Redaction: verified by full-file code read — no console/log statement anywhere in packages/1password/ prints a resolved value; diagnose tool/command reports variable names only. Live redaction dry-run (stdout + transcript) still required per plan.md Task 4.2.1c/d. Subagent inheritance: UNVERIFIED IN CODE — this package has zero subagent-awareness (grep across the whole package and pi-coding-agent 0.84.4 type surface both show no subagent concept); depends entirely on the separate permission-system/subagents fork and must be VERIFIED live per Task 4.2.1e. Upstream: active (daily commits) but single-human-maintained (jmcombs = ~90% of non-bot commits) — bus-factor 1. Fork is 1 non-security commit behind upstream package HEAD. Upstream test suite: 54/54 passing (npx vitest run packages/1password), but index.test.ts itself states the spawnHook injection path is NOT covered by automation.

narumiruna-pi-extensions-plan-mode.notes: [Agent-assisted preparatory review, not Tyler-verified — read before approving.] Reviewed at fork commit 04aae270c51cf4de70479d84317eb15ac8e20e33 (upstream narumiruna/pi-extensions, package packages/pi-plan-mode, MIT — verified LICENSE text identical at repo root and package level, matches package.json). Tool-call gating: verified fail-closed — plan-mode.ts:545-632 blocks edit/write/update_plan unconditionally and gates all other tools behind a frozen per-activation allowlist; bash/powershell get an additional allowlist-based shell parser (tool-policy.ts) where parse failure = block, not allow. Composition with the separate permission-system fork (gotgenes-pi-packages, still candidate): verified against Pi core extension dispatcher (emitToolCall) — the tool_call event type has no allow/override field, only block/reason/terminate, and any extension block:true short-circuits regardless of registration order; plan-mode never expresses an override and calls no tool-activation API. Gap found: state.ts:72 — a malformed persisted plan-mode-state entry silently reverts to enabled:false (fully unrestricted) with no user notification; confirmed by the package own test ("malformed persisted Plan state fails closed", test/plan-mode.test.ts:156). Not a blocker since plan mode is additive to the permission system, but plan mode alone should not be relied on as the sole gate. Upstream: very active (pushed same day as review, 30 releases via changesets) but single-maintainer (narumiruna = 3511 contributions vs. next-highest human contributor at 9) — bus-factor 1, same pattern already noted for jmcombs-pi-1password. Upstream test suite: 265/265 passing (npm install && npm run build && npx vitest run packages/pi-plan-mode/test), tsc --noEmit clean.
